name: Zombie Crisis
steps: Take the stick from the zombie and add it to the ladder.
Take the street light and add it to the ladder.
Take the man from the toilet and place him on the ladder.
Use the man’s belt on the ladder.
Take the toilet sign and add it as a step.
Use the axe on the tree to get a piece of wood, then add it to the ladder.
Tap the bushes to get a broom and add it to the ladder.
Take the water pipe and place it on the ladder.
Put the man playing dead onto the ladder.
Take the nunchucks from the girl’s hand and add them to the ladder to complete the escape.
